info.name: Twilio SendGrid Provisioning Account Categories API

params.name: limit
params.description: `limit` sets the page size, i.e. maximum number of items from the list to be returned for a single API request. If omitted, the default page size is used.

params.name: category
params.description: Allows you to perform a prefix search on this particular category.

params.name: offset
params.description: The number of items in the list to skip over before starting to retrieve the items for the requested page. The default `offset` of `0` represents the beginning of the list, i.e. the start of the first page. To request the second page of the list, set the `offset` to the page size as determined by `limit`. Use multiples of the page size as your `offset` to request further consecutive pages. E.g. assume your page size is set to `10`. An `offset` of `10` requests the second page, an `offset` of `20` requests the third page and so on, provided there are sufficiently many items in your list.

items.docs:
**This endpoint allows you to retrieve a paginated list of all of your categories.**

You can use the `limit` query parameter to set the page size. If your list contains more items than the page size permits, you can make multiple requests. Use the `offset` query parameter to control the position in the list from which to start retrieving additional items.

params.name: start_date
params.description: The starting date of the statistics to retrieve. Must follow format YYYY-MM-DD

params.name: end_date
params.description: The end date of the statistics to retrieve. Defaults to today. Must follow format YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: categories
params.description: The individual categories that you want to retrieve statistics for. You may include up to 10 different categories.

params.name: aggregated_by
params.description: How to group the statistics. Must be either "day", "week", or "month".

items.docs:
**This endpoint allows you to retrieve all of your email statistics for each of your categories.**

If you do not define any query parameters, this endpoint will return a sum for each category in groups of 10.

info.name: Retrieve sums of email stats for each category.

params.name: sort_by_metric
params.description: The metric that you want to sort by.  Must be a single metric.

params.name: sort_by_direction
params.description: The direction you want to sort.

params.name: start_date
params.description: The starting date of the statistics to retrieve. Must follow format YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: end_date
params.description: The end date of the statistics to retrieve. Defaults to today. Must follow format YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: limit
params.description: Limits the number of results returned.

params.name: offset
params.description: The point in the list to begin retrieving results.

params.name: aggregated_by
params.description: How to group the statistics. Must be either "day", "week", or "month".

items.docs:
**This endpoint allows you to retrieve the total sum of each email statistic for every category over the given date range.**

If you do not define any query parameters, this endpoint will return a sum for each category in groups of 10.
